title: Story Writer input contract
description: The static requirement of information. dor_lint.rb is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the shape. DoR is COMPUTED by the lint, never asserted here.

source.description: Cited authority the boundaries come from, e.g. 'AWDWR C3'. Never blank — boundaries are extracted, not invented.

goal.description: As a <operator> I want <capability> so that <value>

predicate.description: Concrete & testable. No vague terms; thresholds carry the exact value.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit exclusions — deferred nice-to-haves land here, not invented into the story.

rejected_solutioning.description: Premature implementation stripped out of the PRD (kept for traceability).

open_questions.description: Batch-mode escalations: genuine product decisions source+code couldn't answer. A card with open_questions is NOT-READY.

options.description: Concrete choices where the agent can offer them
